svg.text: Open design decisions, 2026-11-08 (after the v4 decisions)
Orange = open choice · green = decided by the team (notes/decisions.md) · dashed = work before a run. Source: OPEN_DECISIONS.md.
Claude-authored figure
Decided
R1_TRAP first (11-02)
No ITO; 10 × 10 mm edge-pad dies (11-07)
On-chip via from the Au fill to the Al (11-08)
Architecture: local mirror, no D2 (11-08)
v4 GDS; Si with ρ > 20 kΩ·cm; no ground plane
Leads: Au in a slot along the centre DC (11-08)
Same step as the electrodes, as Hampel 2023
A30 + B60 kept · R1_TRAP on v4 (11-08)
R1_TRAP NODET: Au on SiO₂ over HR Si, no Al
Still open
Electrode Au
E1: 0.35 µm lift-off (no plating)
E2: 6 µm plated (as Todaro)
Blocks the v4 traveler rewrite.
Resolve: SiO₂ exposed in the gaps (E1: 0.07
depth/width), plating effort, resonator tests
Readout radial tilt
v3 needed 13.2 V for 10°, past ±10 V.
v4: A30 6.3 V, B60 2.2 V (load 7.5 V): fits.
Team to confirm 10°.
Options: smaller or zero tilt,
or a wider DAC range
RF grounding / filters
Centre-DC filtering, carrier grounds, RF
bypass at both SNSPD pads (v4 slot leads),
symmetric termination or cancellation.
Resolve: bond diagram, coupling calc,
RF on/off tests
Before any v4 run (work, not choices)
Documents and layouts
· Rewrite traveler, R1_TRAP sheet, mask list, stack for v4
(after the E1/E2 choice; v3 pages carry a banner)
· Rework the test dies for v4 (T2 Au/D2/M1 capacitor and
D2 probe openings no longer exist; no-Al TEST_TRAP)
· Mirror path: via moved, Al 450 nm (decided, +0.2 µA);
add a probe opening and the R acceptance
· Order Si with ρ > 20 kΩ·cm
· MIT.nano: Au tools, plating (if E2), training
Simulations and tests not yet rerun for v4
· Done (09c): cap 160 nm → absorption 0.66 (80 nm: 0.44)
· Done (10b): wire 0.96 µA (E2); slot leads 46 µA each, common mode
· RF loss / resonator Q with no ground plane (bench test)
· Gap model: the local Al under the slot gaps and the
window is not in the gds2itvg stack (ground_depth null)
· Before R1_FULL: detector-doc reconciliation (T9, areas,
EBL time), NbN recipe + W1, W2 EBL, cold tests
